K0 = 0x20010db8000000000000000000000000
fib.append((0, 0, 11))                                   # default route (G0)
for i in range(1, 6):
    fib.append((ref.mask(i << 124, 16), 16, 100 + i))    # G0, depth12 locals -> TYPE1 0 children
for i in range(6):
    fib.append((ref.mask(K0 | (i << 112), 24), 24, 200 + i))   # G16 tree with 6 children -> TYPE2

for i in range(9):
    fib.append((ref.mask(K1 | (i << 106), 30), 30, 300 + i))   # G16 tree with 9 children -> TYPE3+bulk
K2 = 0x4000000000000001
for i in range(2):
    fib.append((ref.mask((K2 << 64) | (i << 58), 70), 70, 400 + i))  # G64 TYPE5

    c_ok = cpp_load(m)
    status = 'OK ' if (c_ok == py_ok == expect) else 'BAD'
    print('%s %-42s cpp=%s py=%s expect=%s %s' % (status, name, c_ok, py_ok, expect, '' if py_ok else reason))
